verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸ ਫਲ ਬਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਫਲੁ ਮੀਠੋ ਖਗ ਤਾ ਪੈ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau s fal ban bikhai birakh bibidh jaa ko fal meeTho khag taa pai chal jaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a fruit orchard has many types of fruit trees, but birds fly only to the one which has sweet fruit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਬਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਪਾਖਾਨ ਬਹੁ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਤੋ ਹੀਰਾ ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜ ਖਨਵਾਰਾ ਲਲਚਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise parabat bikhai dhekheeaai paakhaan bahu jaa mai to heeraa khojee khoj khanavaaraa lalachaat hai ||

en.bdb: Numerous types of stones are available in the mountains but one in search of diamond longs to see the stone that can yield one a diamond.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਜਲਧਿ ਮਧਿ ਬਸਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਜੰਤ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਹੰਸ ਖੋਜ ਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau jaladh madh basat ana(n)t ja(n)t mukataa amol jaa mai ha(n)s khoj khaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a lake is inhabited by many forms of marine life, but a swan visits only that lake which has pearls in its oyster.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਹੈ ਅਸੰਖ ਸਿਖ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਲੋਕ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੬੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur charan saran hai asa(n)kh sikh jaa mai gur giaan taeh lok lapaTaat hai ||366||

en.bdb: Similarly-numerous Sikhs reside in the refuge of the True Guru. But he who has the knowledge of Guru residing in his heart, people feel attracted and enamoured to him. (366)
